decisions.title: Montana pilot branch findings that change the plan (2026-10-11)
decisions.quote: docs/DECISIONS.md:254-255: 'Station observations are hourly, so a 30-minute freshness limit fails most of Montana.'
decisions.what_it_means_for_a_globe: Freshness limits come from each source's measured cadence and show beside each value. One shared limit would hide staleness across satellite, radar and hourly stations.

decisions.title: Product name: Montana Hail Watch (2026-10-12)
decisions.quote: docs/DECISIONS.md:310-312: check Montana Hail Watch against existing products and trademarks before it goes on an installer, a release page or anything printed; HailTrace is an existing hail-mapping service sold to roofers, so stay clear of that name too.
decisions.what_it_means_for_a_globe: Any globe name (scaffold D-G6) needs the same trademark check. The site header already reads Montana Hail Watch (base.html:23).

decisions.title: A website first; the desktop app is parked (2026-10-14)
decisions.quote: docs/DECISIONS.md:315-316: 'The product is now a static website in website/, built by Python and published with GitHub Pages'. docs/DECISIONS.md:340-341: 'Snapshot, not live tiles: the radar is saved as one picture per build'.
decisions.what_it_means_for_a_globe: A globe is another static page built by website/build.py: no app window, route or installer. Each build is one snapshot; a time loop needs persistence the site lacks (website_pipeline.rebuild_model).

decisions.title: An interactive Montana map in the style of Apple Weather (2026-10-15)
decisions.quote: docs/DECISIONS.md:382-384: 'playback, scrubbing, menus, sheets and geolocation can only happen in the browser ... Python still builds every number and frame.' docs/DECISIONS.md:380-381: 'The USGS tiles and the Folium maps are retired from the website'.
decisions.what_it_means_for_a_globe: WebGL drawing is browser-only work under the same rule: hand-written, documented, framework-free, with Python building every frame. No tile base map exists to reuse.

decisions.title: Live station readings on the Now page and town pages (2026-10-16)
decisions.quote: docs/DECISIONS.md:464-465: 'A reading older than 75 minutes is kept and marked stale with its age, never hidden.'
decisions.what_it_means_for_a_globe: Old globe values are kept, marked with their age and never hidden. D29's extra requests and build time (44 s) show that globe data must fit the 15-minute job (website.yml:38).

website_pipeline.layout: index, map, reports, about (.html); town/<slug>.html x14; static/ copied from website/static (379); data/map.json; data/state.json; map/frames/<layer>-<UTC valid time>[-r<run hour>].png (gridded.py:40, 126-135).
website_pipeline.rebuild_model: _site is removed and rebuilt each run (build.py:375-379); gridded writes only this run's frames (gridded.py:984-988); the Pages artifact is packaged from this run's _site (website.yml:155-159). Earlier frames are not served.
website_pipeline.asset_versions: style.css, map.js, map.css, basemap.json: ?v=<content hash> (build.py:361-370; base.html:12; map.html:15, 35, 192). map.json and the card iframe: ?v=<build minute> (map.html:24, 34; index.html:43).
website_pipeline.previous_state: --previous loads the live state.json (build.py:472-478; website.yml:92) and reuses the last verified alerts, points and stations when a request fails (build.py:55-62, 74, 130).

gridded.mrms: CONUS/PrecipRate_00.00 only, noaa-mrms-pds (gridded.py:44-46). Whole gzipped CONUS GRIB2 file per frame, no byte range (456, 679); full grid 24.5 million points (453-454). Decoded with pygrib (455, 464); checks: 209/6/1 (47, 458-459), regular lat-lon (460-461), time within 2 min of name (462-463). Seven frames at 10-minute steps; a target with no file within 4 min is skipped; one failed frame drops all radar frames (50-52, 533-549, 683).
gridded.hrrr: noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds, hrrr.YYYYMMDD/conus/hrrr.tHHz.wrf{sfc|subh}fNN.grib2 (gridded.py:48, 554-556). PRATE (0,1,7) to mm/h; TMP 2 m (0,0,0) to F; GUST (0,2,22) to mph (63-68). One whole-grid field per byte-range request from the .idx (574-585, 738-740). Precipitation: 12 hourly plus quarter-hour steps; temperature and gusts: run hour plus 12 (594-601, 712-725). Grid, field and time checked (467-478); own Lambert projection checked against pygrib (222-225; test_gridded.py:408). Run: newest with a published .idx, up to 4 tries (57, 604-625).
gridded.crop: IMAGE_BOUNDS ((43.0,-118.5),(50.5,-101.0)) shared by all frames (gridded.py:38; build.py:237). No crop at download; the crop is sampling after decode: MRMS nearest neighbour, HRRR bilinear (156-163, 177-198, 222-258). Widths 1400 px precipitation, 700 px temperature and gusts (39, 149-153).
gridded.format: Palette PNG; index 0 transparent, 1 hatch, then levels (319-327, 363-372). Levels: precipitation 48, temperature 126, gusts 76 (91). Sigma 1 px smoothing, NaN kept (92, 261-279). Legend built in Python (398-429).
gridded.nodata: MRMS negative values (no coverage) become NaN (191-198); NaN and negative precipitation are hatched, never drawn as dry (338-360); radar frames carry a nodata flag (692-693).
gridded.cadence: Every build; cron */10 (website.yml:15). Radar not ok when the newest file is over 30 min old (gridded.py:53, 699-701). Forecast anchored to the newest radar time if within 30 min, else the current hour (1002).
gridded.counts_and_bytes: 48 frames = 22 precipitation (7 radar, 15 forecast) + 13 temperature + 13 wind (594-601; live result). Live build, clear sky: frames 2,696,906 bytes (temperature mean 92,886; wind mean 111,991; precipitation 33,497; largest 116,694). One live build downloaded 45,673,824 bytes in 198 requests: HRRR 34,727,683; NWS 7,300,426; MRMS 3,639,199 (scratchpad count/stderr.txt; DECISIONS.md:388 says about 40 MB).
gridded.failures: A layer keeps forecast frames only if all of them loaded (gridded.py:757-758); build_gridded never raises (991-994, 1005-1008); sample frames are labelled SAMPLE (108-110).

sources_contracts.keys: alerts, points, hourly, gusts, daily, stations, observations, reports, radar, forecast_model, basemap (sources.py:45-138).
sources_contracts.entries: alerts: NWS area=MT plus a point check per town, each build; no-outline alerts listed with a note (46-53). hourly: degF; a wind range takes the higher number (61-67). gusts: km/h or m/s to mph; other units are an error (68-74). stations: nearest three, never filtered by state (82-90; OBS_STATIONS 33). observations: degC, km/h, kt converted; MADIS flags; X and B withheld (91-101). reports: SPC hail in hundredths of an inch; UNK wind unknown; reporting day 12:00-11:59 UTC (102-109). radar: MRMS 0.01 deg grid, one file every 2 min; over 30 min is stale (110-118). forecast_model: HRRR PRATE, TMP, GUST on a 3 km Lambert grid; labelled as a model (119-129). basemap: Natural Earth and Census, built by hand (130-137).
sources_contracts.evidence_kinds: No kind field in CONTRACTS. Frames carry kind radar or forecast (gridded.py:692, 754; test_site.py:503). Each source has a status (build.py:44-45).
sources_contracts.fetch: Fetcher: 20 s timeout; 3 attempts; pauses 1.5 s and 3.0 s; 5xx and network errors retried; 404 = not published, not retried (sources.py:619, 624-642).
sources_contracts.boxes: MT_BOX 44.35-49.01 N, 116.06-104.03 W; SPC margin 0.75 deg (sources.py:24-25, 572-574). Map view equals MT_BOX (build.py:216).
sources_contracts.limits: Gust 25 mph; wind 20 mph; rain or snow 30%; under 40 F; over 95 F. Placeholders (sources.py:41; ROADMAP.md:44-45).

freshness_rules: Radar not ok when the newest MRMS file is over 30 min (1800 s) old (gridded.py:53, 699-701; sources.py:115).
No radar frames at all when the newest file is over 3 h (10800 s) old (gridded.py:54, 671-673). A frame takes a file within 4 min (240 s), else is skipped (gridded.py:52, 533-549).
Radar tick and ', now' words: within 10 min (600 s) of the newest frame (map.js:911, 1158).
Station reading current at 75 min (4500 s) or less; older readings kept and marked stale with their age (sources.py:34, 517; town.html:60).
Base pages warn when over 25 min (1500 s) old, comparing build time with the viewer's clock (base.html:47-62; about.html:36).
Base pages meta-refresh every 600 s (base.html:6). map.html has no refresh and does not extend base.html (map.html:1-23).
Map page age checked every 60 s; banner when over 25 min (map.js:21, 24, 167-168, 1682-1702).
Map update check at most once a minute (map.js:1659-1666). A failed picture is retried after 10 s, on the viewer's own step (map.js:22, 1012).
Alerts fetched each build, about every 10 min; a failed request keeps the last verified list (sources.py:50; build.py:55-62).
HRRR: newest run with a published .idx, up to 4 hourly tries (gridded.py:57, 604-625).
Cron every 10 min; concurrency per ref, no cancel (website.yml:15, 31-33). Geolocation: 12 s timeout, 5 min cache (map.js:1776).
Picture names must be unique per picture; Pages may let a browser reuse a file for 10 min (gridded.py:128-131; DESIGN.md:375-377).

what_the_globe_plan_must_change: 1 Re-base sections 1 and 5-7 from the desktop app to the website: static pages built by website/build.py and published by website.yml; no window, payload, /globe route, selftest, installer or Live Storms tab (DECISIONS.md:314-321; build.py:397-409; website.yml:155-175).

2 Replace the 50 MB cap, network-off self-test and 'tens of MB every 2 minutes' (section 1 points 5-6) with measured limits: one live build downloads 45.7 MB (HRRR 34.7, NWS 7.3, MRMS 3.6) and writes 3.9 MB; the 15-minute build job (website.yml:38) and 10-minute cron (website.yml:15) bind.
3 Replace D-G4's pinned CDN library with vendoring under website/static/, pinned exactly as Leaflet 1.9.4 is (AGENTS.md:71-72; map.html:14, 191; test_site.py:459-471).

4 Decide where heavy processing runs. Pages publishes only the _site of the run that built it (website.yml:155-159), and build.py rebuilds _site from empty each run (build.py:375-376). A second job must produce the whole site, or the globe's files are built in the same run.

5 Add persistence before any time loop. No past frame survives a build (build.py:375-376; gridded.py:984-988). Section 3's 2-hour loop needs the --previous state (build.py:472-478) or a frame cache (ROADMAP.md:50-52; not built).

6 Replace D12's freshness limits (GOES 15, MRMS 10, alerts 10) with the site's: radar 30 min (gridded.py:53), station 75 min (sources.py:34), page 25 min (base.html:57), alerts each build (sources.py:50). Settle the 15-vs-30 conflict first (doc_drift 1).

7 Use the site's gap words: No radar coverage, No model data, Outside map area (map.js:33-39); 'This is not an all-clear.' (map.html:52-59); 'Data unavailable' only where the site uses it (map.js:2093). 'No echo is not clear' must match DESIGN.md:275-276.

8 Replace USGS imagery (D9; scaffold W6) with a licensed, hostable source: USGS tiles were retired (DECISIONS.md:379-381); the site's base map is Natural Earth and Census under 450,000 bytes (tools/build_basemap.py:96). Each source goes in the About table (about.html:41-54).
9 Replace the flat fallback 'NWS WMS base reflectivity (D7)' with the site's own MRMS PrecipRate frames (gridded.py:44-47, 126-135; DECISIONS.md:373-375).

10 Remove places, territories, jobs and candidates (DESIGN.md:26, 51; DECISIONS.md:322-325). Use the 14 towns (towns.json) inside the site's boxes: frame 43.0-50.5 N, 118.5-101.0 W (gridded.py:38); view 44.35-49.01 N, 116.06-104.03 W (build.py:216).

11 Replace D-G7 and section 7 risk 3 with the site's audience: phones from 288 px to 1440 px desktops, in sunlight, over slow connections (DESIGN.md:23, 29-30). Real-phone checks are not done (ROADMAP.md:41-43); Chromium checks run only on branch pushes (website.yml:96-105).

12 Redo D-G5 placement. The site has four top-level pages (base.html:25-30; build.py:397-403) and a map-card iframe on Now and Storm reports (index.html:43-44). A globe is a fifth page, a card or a replacement; DESIGN.md:89-97 rejected the full-width map first on phones. Test against T1-T4 and X1-X3 (DESIGN.md:72-80).
13 Redo D-G6 naming: the product is Montana Hail Watch (D26; base.html:23). Run the trademark check D26 requires and avoid HailTrace (DECISIONS.md:310-312).

14 Replace section 3's 'Kind (D12)' column with the site's separation: radar and model kinds per frame and per source (gridded.py:692-693, 754-756; map.js:1136-1169). AGENTS.md:73-76 keeps forecast, radar estimate, observation and official alert apart.
15 Carry the disclaimer into the globe legend or footer: 'Weather information only. It does not confirm roof damage' (base.html:45; DESIGN.md:167-168).

16 Re-point section 6's tests: CONTRACTS in website/sources.py (AGENTS.md:80-84; test_site.py:350). The 240 alert scenarios do not run in the website workflow (website.yml:84). Add a page-uses-only-site-files test (test_site.py:459-471) and a Chromium check like tools/smoke_map.py (website.yml:96-101).

17 Update the path filter and test command for any new module or test. Changes under research/ do not trigger the site build (website.yml:19-26); new tests run only if added to the command (website.yml:84).

18 Price the JavaScript: a WebGL loader is hand-written, documented, framework-free code with a stated budget (AGENTS.md:66-72). map.js is already 2,155 lines; moving about 330 lines to the build is an open decision (ROADMAP.md:60-65; DECISIONS.md:385-387).

19 Generate the globe page with Jinja and build.py data, as map.html and map.json are (build.py:397-413; map.html:33-36). The browser may fetch only site files (map.js:9; test_site.py:459-471), so D-G2's tile production must write into the site folder.

20 Keep the text-version promise. The map has a text List and says its pictures have no text version (map.js:2065-2112; map.html:38-41; ROADMAP.md:55-59). A 3D view must list its values as text too, or repeat that statement.
